title: Local MAHI test hang fixed after RFC027 handoff
status: local test hang fixed; does not resolve live RFC027 MM divergence

history_ingested.required_context: This entry updates the stale local-test caveat from experiments 277 and 278 after re-ingesting the full experiment history. It only changes the validation guidance for local MAHI tests; item 277 remains the active live RFC027 MM/taker/candle diagnostic.

problem.summary: The RFC027 live handoff warned that broad local MAHI tests were known to hang. That caveat is now stale.
problem.root_cause: The RPC MAHI test hang was a same-thread self-deadlock: a test held the global env-var mutex through with_env_vars, then called consensus_metrics, which called with_legacy_delegation_bridge_enabled, which called with_env_vars again and tried to lock the same non-reentrant mutex.
problem.secondary_build_issue: The consensus MAHI test binary also failed to build because MahiBlock gained a faucets: Vec<BlockFaucet> field and two test constructors were missing faucets: Vec::new().

changes.change: Added faucets: Vec::new() to the two MahiBlock test constructors that predated the new faucets payload field.

Made the test-only with_env_vars helper reentrant for nested same-thread calls by adding a thread-local ENV_LOCK_DEPTH counter. The outer call still holds the global env lock against other test threads; nested calls skip re-locking but keep their own save/set/restore behavior. The helper now also restores env vars and decrements depth before resuming unwinds if the callback panics.

validation.reported_result: All 72 local MAHI tests pass: 27 consensus + 11 node + 34 RPC, in about 1.07s total.
validation.verified_result: Re-run locally in this workspace after the experiment update: 27 consensus MAHI tests passed, 11 node MAHI tests passed, and 34 RPC MAHI tests passed. The RPC filter, which previously hung, completed in 1.13s test time after making with_env_vars unwind-safe.
warnings: The node/RPC test builds still emit RFC042 durable-helper dead-code warnings because live production paths are not cut over to durable variants yet.
validation.interpretation: Broad local MAHI tests are usable regression checks again. Passing them is not proof that the live RFC027 MM bot, taker bot, market-data, and candle path are fixed.

live_rfc027_status.reason: The live issue in item 277 is cross-validator read-model/orderbook divergence: committed_state_root and MAHI commit_log_hash can match while MAHI state_hash and orderbook contents disagree. The local test-hang fix does not address that production diagnostic.
live_rfc027_status.next_debugging_gate: Audit typed SingleNodeEngine mutations and add a multi-validator MAHI test that proves one maker and one taker intent produce identical orderbook, positions, trade history, runtime events, intent status, committed root, and MAHI state hash across validators.

review_notes: Keep this change separate from unrelated RPC read-model/notional-scaling changes if committing. The MAHI hang fix is small and test-helper scoped.
do_not_repeat: Do not leave stale experiment caveats in place after validation assumptions change.
Do not treat local MAHI test success as proof that live MM/taker/candle behavior is fixed.
Do not mix unrelated UI/RPC read-model fixes into the MAHI-test-hang commit without explicit review.
